description:
Hostile Intercept

and Autopause!

Download v1.6.0

This utility mod adds radiating rings around hostile and intercepting fleets so you can easily spot them. It also adds autopause!

Features:

- Hostile fleets/stations radiate red rings

- Fleets chasing you or looking for you radiate grey rings

- Autopause!

- Jump point autopause

Autopause only works while a course is set, and vice versa for jump point autopause. You can enable/disable them in settings.json, or modify them temporarily mid-game using

Console Commands

.

Two fleets chasing the player and one chasing the pirate fleet[close]

aiDescription: Adds radiating red rings around hostile fleets and grey rings around fleets chasing the player, making them easy to spot. Introduces autopause when a course is set, and pause after jumping if no course is set. Features can be toggled via settings or console commands, with options to limit autopause to threat detection.
